description: Agents installed by their vendors' own curl installers, the route no package manager records.
why: Each installer's own script names where it writes, and each of those places is already enumerated: a file directly under ~/.local/bin, or a top-level ~/.<dir>/. So these agents were invisible for want of a catalog value, not a query. Nothing else on this host can name any of them -- no npm global, no package, no editor -- so removing a value turns its must_find red. Pi's installer runs npm ci into ~/.pi/agent/install, which npm_packages does not read; forbid_rows holds both its npm names absent, so an installer that starts writing an npm global fails here rather than adding a second witness unseen. claude-code and codex-cli are forbidden because their own routes are ~/.local/bin and top-level home directories too, and new neighbours there must not be read as either. openclaw is forbidden because it is built on Pi's libraries.
known_gaps: Only the installers' Linux branches run here. On macOS opencode, Cursor CLI, goose and Kiro CLI are proved through Homebrew in 21-cli-agents-homebrew, Muse Code by the same installer in 14-meta-muse, and Pi's installer runs in 20-cli-agents; Grok Build's macOS install is unexercised, though ~/.grok is a posix route.

Nothing is run after installing, so state that appears on first use -- ~/.config/goose, ~/.local/share/opencode, ~/.muse -- is unexamined. Only the last is a top-level directory the enumeration would reach, and it is not a catalog value.
